summary: Implementation in commit d2e673c9e fully achieves the saved plan for #477. bitbucket_client_errors.py adds the deterministic BITBUCKET_COMMIT_RESOLVE_FAILED reason code (distinct from transient codes) with a documenting comment, and bitbucket_client.py imports + re-exports it via __all__. _resolve_full_commit_sha(repo, sha) early-returns a >=40-char hash with NO HTTP call and otherwise resolves the abbreviated hash via a single cached per-commit GET (using quote(sha)), raising the new reason-coded BitBucketClientError on a non-dict / missing / too-short hash instead of silently falling back. fetch_pr_status resolves the head AFTER the None guard (so the missing-head case still raises first) but BEFORE the commit-statuses fetch and before _remember_pr, so PRStatus.head_sha, the statuses fetch path, and the remembered rerun pipeline target (_PRContext.source_sha) are all the full 40-char hash; _remember_pr now takes a head_sha kwarg. Tests cover (a) abbreviated->full with statuses keyed on the full path, (b) full hash makes no resolve GET, (c) prefix sanity, (e) both transient-propagation and BITBUCKET_COMMIT_RESOLVE_FAILED (short-hash + non-dict), plus a unit-level early-return test; (d) GitHub path is untouched. fetch_failing_check_logs needs no change (head supplied from the now-full PRStatus.head_sha). All documented non-goals (validation-gate equality, GitHub, #475, resolve_thread/merge semantics, dest_sha) are untouched. Validation evidence is recorded in ws_ba6772382bc949b0a7aa3342.validation.md (41 BitBucket part_002 tests pass; ruff, ruff format --check, and mypy clean on the touched files); the whole-suite run and the aggregate 99% coverage gate are AWF/CI-owned after the agent phase per the workspace contract, and every new branch has a focused test so coverage does not drop.
